provenance.item-bg: Toast.css --toast-background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) -> characteristics/container.css -> palette-background-primary -> snow #FFFFFF light / jet #101820 dark. Identical slot/value to alert.salt.json's own container-bg (does NOT vary by type).
provenance.item-fg: Toast.tsx div has no own color rule; the div inherits --salt-content-primary-foreground the same way Banner.css's own root text colour does — #000000 light / #FFFFFF dark. Identical slot/value to alert.salt.json's content-fg.
provenance.type-*: Toast.css .saltToast-{status} { --toast-borderColor: var(--salt-status-{status}-borderColor); --toast-iconColor: var(--salt-status-{status}-foreground-decorative) } -> characteristics/status.css -> palette-{info,negative,warning,positive} base (500 stop), mode-invariant. Reused verbatim from alert.salt.json's own tone-* slots — Toast.css and Banner.css both consume the exact same status token family for the exact same purpose (border color AND icon color driven by ONE status value).
provenance.item-elevation: Toast.css box-shadow: var(--salt-overlayable-shadow-popout) -> next/characteristics/overlayable.css -> next/palette/shadow.css --salt-shadow-mediumLow. Value reused from docs/foundations/elevation.md (0 6px 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2) light / 0.55 dark), the same reuse select.salt.json/tabs.salt.json/tooltip.salt.json all made for the identical slot.
provenance.byDensity.item-padding: Toast.css padding: var(--saltToast-padding, var(--salt-spacing-100)) -> foundations/spacing.css spacing-100 unit, uniform on all sides (a real CONTRAST with Banner.css's own split spacing-50/spacing-100).
provenance.byDensity.item-gap: Toast.css gap: var(--salt-spacing-75) -> foundations/spacing.css, 0.75x the density unit. Same slot family alert.salt.json's own banner-gap used.
provenance.byDensity.item-margin: Toast.css margin: 0 var(--salt-spacing-100) var(--salt-spacing-100) var(--salt-spacing-100) -> foundations/spacing.css spacing-100 unit, all three non-top sides. `.saltToast:last-child { margin-bottom: var(--salt-spacing-200) }` is a real, sourced, LAST-CHILD-ONLY override not modelled here (this template has no last-child-specific row; declared, not silently dropped).
provenance.byDensity.item-shape: Toast.css border-radius: var(--saltToast-borderRadius, var(--salt-palette-corner, 0)) -> next/palette/corner.css [data-corner="rounded"] curve-150, the same rounded-edition pin alert/calendar/button all use.
provenance.byDensity.item-min-height: Toast.css min-height: calc(var(--salt-size-base) + var(--salt-spacing-100)) -> foundations/size.css size-base + foundations/spacing.css spacing-100, both density-scaled. IDENTICAL formula and slot family to alert.salt.json's own banner-min-height (Banner.css and Toast.css derive this the same way).
provenance.byDensity.icon-size: Toast.css .saltToast-iconContainer > .saltIcon margin-top calc includes max(var(--salt-size-icon), 12px) as its own clamp term — docs/foundations/sizes.md size-icon = 10/12/14/16 by density, clamped to a 12px floor -> 12/12/14/16. Same clamp select.salt.json's own toggle-icon-size derivation already established for the identical --salt-size-icon token.
provenance.byDensity.group-width: ToastGroup.css [data-density] blocks: literal, non-derived per-density widths (210/260/310/360px) — NOT a multiple of the spacing/size unit, a real per-density LITERAL, unlike most of Salt's own density-scaled tokens.
provenance.byDensity.type-body: characteristics/text.css 'Body text' block: --salt-text-fontFamily (Open Sans), -fontWeight (regular=400), -fontSize/-lineHeight (density-scaled) -> Toast.css font-family/-size/-weight/line-height. Identical slot/value family to alert.salt.json's own type-body.
provenance.zindex: ToastGroup.css z-index: var(--salt-zIndex-flyover) -> docs/foundations/layers.md flyover = 1500, the same slot tabs.salt.json's own popup z-index already cites.
provenance.tokens-only-note: packages/core/src/toast (Toast, ToastContent) and packages/lab/src/toast-group (ToastGroup) are both real, live, fully-inspectable Salt components — every structure/behavior/style cell in this column is [S] unless individually marked [R].

structure.icon.source:
Toast.tsx: {status &&
{icon ? icon : }
} — rendered ONLY when `status` (this chassis's `type`) is set

structure.description.note: no dedicated title/description split — ToastContent's children are freeform; a two-line look is a content-formatting convention only (toast.stories.tsx 'Info'/'Error'/'Warning' stories nest a bold <Text> and a plain <div> inside ONE ToastContent, same convention as Banner's bold-first-line)

structure.action.note: NO dedicated actions wrapper exists in Toast.tsx (unlike Banner's BannerActions) — action buttons in toast.stories.tsx's Error/Warning exports are ordinary <Button> children composed inside ToastContent's own FlowLayout, no distinct data-slot hook. A real structural CONTRAST with alert/banner, not an oversight — see TOAST-MATRIX.md Findings.

structure.close.note: no dedicated close part — an ordinary <Button appearance="transparent" aria-label="Dismiss"> composed as a free child (toast.stories.tsx, toast-group.stories.tsx's closeToast pattern), same composition convention Banner's own close used

behavior.role.source: Toast.tsx: role="alert" HARDCODED, always — <div ... role="alert" {...rest} ref={ref}>. A real CONTRAST with alert.salt.json's own Banner column, which has NO default role at all.

behavior.auto-dismiss.note: CONFIRMED OFF — no setTimeout/timer of any kind anywhere in Toast.tsx, ToastContent.tsx or ToastGroup.tsx (grepped directly). site/docs/components/toast/usage.mdx states directly: 'Users should always be able to close or dismiss a toast' — Salt toasts are PERSISTENT by design until manually dismissed. toast-group.stories.tsx's own ToastEntryType/useState array management confirms: every example toast holds its own `open` useState with NO automatic expiry.

behavior.pause-on-interaction.note: no timer exists to pause (see behavior.auto-dismiss)

behavior.swipe-dismiss.note: no swipe/gesture code anywhere in Toast.tsx/ToastContent.tsx (grepped, confirmed absent)

prop.type.source: Toast.tsx status?: ValidationStatus -> status-indicator/ValidationStatus.ts ValidationStatusValues, no forced default (undefined status renders no icon/colour at all, unlike Banner's default "info")

prop.position.source: ToastGroup.tsx placement?: "top-right" | "bottom-right", default "bottom-right" — bottom-right listed first per the value[0]-is-source-default convention

style.item.background.note: does NOT vary by type — only border/icon do (see style.item.type@error etc)

style.item.border-color.note: status-driven indirection, identical mechanism to alert.salt.json's own border-color row

style.item.margin.note: Salt-only: inter-toast spacing is owned by the ITEM's own margin, not the group (see style.group.gap being off for Salt)

style.item.width.note: the fixed width lives on the GROUP (ToastGroup.css --toastGroup-width), not the item — see style.group.width

style.icon.color.note: StatusIndicator resolves to the SAME palette-{status} value as the border — genuinely independent of the body text colour, identical mechanism to alert.salt.json's own icon colour

style.description.color.note: structure.description is off — no description part to colour

style.group.position.source: ToastGroup.css .saltToastGroup-bottom-right { bottom: 0; right: 0; justify-content: flex-end } (the default placement)

style.group.gap.note: no gap property on ToastGroup.css's own root rule — inter-toast spacing is owned by the ITEM's own margin instead (see style.item.margin)
